say:4:1310423001:0.text: Everyone, the undead have been dealt with by our brave warriors! In the name of the Archduke of Whiteridge, I'm happy to announce—the ball will go on!
say:4:1310423001:0.source_cn: 各位，闹事者已被驱离，活死人也被无畏的勇士们制服了！现...

say:5:1310423002:1.text: The goddess is watching over us, and under her protection, we shall finish this festival!
say:5:1310423002:1.source_cn: 至高无上的神明在注视着我们，我们必能在神的护佑下完成祭典！

say:6:1310423003:1.text: Wait, what? After all that just happened, we're really going to keep dancing?
say:6:1310423003:1.source_cn: 什么？都出了这样可怕的事情，还要继续奏乐，继续跳舞？

say:7:1310423004:0.text: Miss Hammie, it is precisely because the undead instill fear that the ball must proceed.
say:7:1310423004:0.source_cn: 漫漫女士，其实正是因为大家都惧怕活死人，所以舞会才要继续。

say:9:1310423006:0.text: According to the ancient legends of Whiteridge, these undead are said to be servants of Hypogeans, and this festival commemorates the heroes who once vanquished them.
say:9:1310423006:0.source_cn: 在白山的传说中，这些活死人都是恶魔的眷属，而祭典却是为...

say:10:1310423007:0.text: Every tradition of the festival is carefully observed, leading to the selection of the "Chosen One" who lights the hero's ice sculpture—an act meant to invoke the hero's spirit for protection against the Hypogeans.
say:10:1310423007:0.source_cn: 人们会认真完成祭典的每个环节，从中选出“受选者”来点亮...

say:11:1310423008:0.text: I see... But isn't it still dangerous with so many people around?
say:11:1310423008:0.source_cn: 原来如此……可是，这么多人，还是很危险啊……

say:12:1310423009:0.text: I shall be ever more vigilant. Fortunately, the festival is drawing to its close. After the ball, the time will come for the lighting of the ice sculpture.
say:12:1310423009:0.source_cn: 我会更加戒备的。还好……祭典已经进入尾声，舞会之后就是...

say:17:1310425001:1.text: Ladies and gentlemen, this year's "Chosen One" has been selected!
say:17:1310425001:1.source_cn: 女士们，先生们，这位就是今年祭典的“受选者”！

say:18:1310425002:1.text: After the ball, please proceed to the ceremony site to witness the most sacred moment of the Snowspire Festival!
say:18:1310425002:1.source_cn: 舞会结束后，请大家前往仪式现场，一起见证冬日祭典中最为...

say:22:1310425003:1.text: Oh, there's something you might not know. Before the lighting, the Chosen One has to offer a <style="highlight">seven-petaled sapphirine blossom</style> to the ice sculpture!
say:22:1310425003:1.source_cn: 对了，你们还不知道吧，点火之前，“受选者”需要为冰雕献...

say:23:1310425004:1.text: But Chippy thought sapphirine blossoms only had six petals?
say:23:1310425004:1.source_cn: 可是……公主殿下，蓝绒花不是六瓣的吗？

say:24:1310425005:1.text: Yes! But there are super rare seven-petaled ones too. In Whiteridge, the seven-petaled sapphirine blossom is a symbol of <style="highlight">"miracles"</style>—it's like a sign of the ancient heroes' will.
say:24:1310425005:1.source_cn: 是呀！但是也有七瓣的蓝绒花。在白山，七瓣的蓝绒花是<s...

say:25:1310425006:1.text: My history tutor used to say that the war against the Hypogeans was an impossible war to win.
say:25:1310425006:1.source_cn: 历史老师说，过去与恶魔的抗争非常惨烈，几乎是不可能赢的战争。

say:26:1310425007:1.text: The heroes had no chance, until a miracle happened.
say:26:1310425007:1.source_cn: 但是，“奇迹”发生了——古代的英雄们最终赢得了胜利。

say:27:1310425008:1.text: So, it's kind of like finding a flower with a seventh petal. It feels impossible, but everyone believes in it.
say:27:1310425008:1.source_cn: 在渺小得可怜的概率下战胜恶魔，与在几万分之一的概率下生...

say:28:1310425009:1.text: And hey, who doesn't need a little bit of luck sometimes?
say:28:1310425009:1.source_cn: 毕竟，谁不需要一点好运呢！

choice_prompt:29:1310425009.text: And hey, who doesn't need a little bit of luck sometimes?
choice_prompt:29:1310425009.source_cn: 毕竟，谁不需要一点好运呢！

say:30:1310425010:1.text: You can try searching the <style="highlight">Floral Ruins</style>, just east of Cedartown. You're blessed as the "Chosen One", so I'm sure you'll find it!

say:30:1310425010:1.male: You can try searching the <style="highlight">Floral Ruins</style>, just east of Cedartown. You're blessed as the "Chosen One", so I'm sure you'll find it!
say:30:1310425010:1.female: You can try searching the <style="highlight">Floral Ruins</style>, just east of Cedartown. You're blessed as the "Chosen One", so I'm sure you'll find it!

say:31:1310425011:0.text: I'll be waiting for you with my father at the ceremony site!
say:31:1310425011:0.source_cn: 我和父亲在仪式会场等你们哦！

say:33:1310425012:0.text: Her Highness' suggestion is sound, and the lighting ceremony happens to take place near the Floral Ruins.
say:33:1310425012:0.source_cn: 公主殿下的提议确实很好，正好点火仪式也在遗迹花海附近举行。

say:34:1310425013:0.text: Mr. Faramor, are you coming with us?
say:34:1310425013:0.source_cn: 法拉莫尔先生，你要和我们一起吗？

say:35:1310425014:1.text: Yes. In light of the recent events, I must patrol the ceremony site before the lighting commences.
say:35:1310425014:1.source_cn: 嗯，正好，刚才出了那些事，我得在点火仪式前再去会场周围...

say:36:1310425015:1.text: But first, let's get some rest. We'll head out bright and early tomorrow!
say:36:1310425015:1.source_cn: 那么，咱们先好好休息一晚，明天一早就出发吧！

narration:37:1310425016:0.text: The night fades into day, and with the sunrise comes another morning.
narration:37:1310425016:0.source_cn: 月亮和黑夜一同来了又去，太阳升起，你们迎来了又一个清晨

choice:29:1:2.male: Where can I find that flower?
choice:29:1:2.female: Where can I find that flower?
